summary: All corpus table constructs are mapped: grid/merge/widths, row/cell borders, paragraph + row borders, cell/row/character/paragraph shading, cell margins, explicit cell widths, hideMark, diagonal cell borders and the \brdrtbl inherit reference. The only unmapped table construct is nested tables (\itap>1), which have no corpus witness and stay an explicit bounded Reject.
implemented: table conditional-formatting look maps to w:tblLook: \tbllkhdrrows -> first_row, \tbllkhdrcols -> first_column, \tbllklastrow -> last_row, \tbllklastcol -> last_column, \tbllknocolband -> no_v_band (\tbllknorowband -> no_h_band), applied at table creation from the first row; \rtlrow/\ltrrow -> w:bidiVisual.

the character-grid / table-growth / layout compat controls (\cgrid, \snaptogridincell, \nocxsptable, \nogrowautofit, \usenormstyforlist, \irow, \irowband, \lastrow, \lytcalctblwd) are Info (no WML equivalent).

borders are mapped by a parser state machine for the grammar `<edge> <style> \brdrw? \brsp? \brdrcf?`: paragraph \brdrt/b/l/r -> w:pBdr, \brdrbar/\brdrbtw -> w:pBdr bar/between, cell \clbrdr{t,b,l,r} -> w:tcBorders, row \trbrdr{t,b,l,r,h,v} -> w:tblPrEx/w:tblBorders, diagonal \cldgll/\cldglu -> w:tcBorders tl2br/tr2bl. Style tokens cover single/thick/double/dotted/dashed/nil/none/inset/outset/triple, the dash and thin-thick families and wave; \brdrwN (twips) -> w:sz eighths clamped to ST_EighthsPoint, \brdrcfN resolved through the colour table, \brspN -> w:space points.
\clbrdX\brdrtbl makes the cell edge inherit the table border (the override is dropped); the token is not a loss.

shading is mapped for cells (\clcbpat/\clcfpat/\clshdng/\clshdrawnil -> w:tcBorders shading), rows (\trcbpat/\trcfpat/\trshdng -> every cell of the row lacking its own shading), runs (\chcbpat/\chcfpat/\chshdng -> w:rPr/w:shd) and paragraphs (\cbpat/\cfpat/\shading). The RTF shading intensity maps to ST_Shd: 0 -> clear, 10000 -> solid, otherwise the nearest pctNN.

cell margins (\clpad{t,b,l,r}) -> w:tcMar, the table half cell-gap (\trgaph) -> w:tblCellMar left/right, hideMark (\clhidemark) -> w:hideMark, and explicit cell width (\clftsWidth/\clwWidth) -> w:tcW (dxa/pct/auto/nil).
\tblind/\tblindtype/\alntblind are Info: the indent is carried by the row position (\trleft) and WPS writes no w:tblInd for the corpus.

page/section borders \pgbrdr{t,b,l,r} -> the section w:pgBorders edges (style/width/colour/space); \pgbrdrhead/\pgbrdrfoot/\pgbrdropt are Info and the art style \brdrart has no Strict ST_Border form, so it drops the edge and stays an explicit Loss.

character borders \chbrdr (+ style/width) -> the single run border w:rPr/w:bdr; the reader now retains w:bdr instead of discarding it. The shared Borders model gained between/bar/tl2br/tr2bl (writer emits each only in its own container, reader parses them).
out_of_scope: the shared renderer does not stroke w:pBdr edges (only their top/bottom pads affect spacing) and does not paint run borders or cell diagonals; it does draw w:tcBorders/w:tblPrEx/w:pgBorders. Renderer gap, not an import gap.
remaining: nested tables (\itap > 1): no corpus witness; kept as an explicit bounded Reject (`nested-table-structure`) rather than a flatten.

assertions: \tbllk* reach w:tblLook flags, \rtlrow reaches w:bidiVisual, both survive Strict write -> reopen
\cgrid/\irow/\irowband/\lastrow/\snaptogridincell produce zero Loss and appear as Info
\clbrdrt\brdrs\brdrw20\brdrcf1 -> w:tcBorders/w:top single w:sz=8 colour FF0000; the other edges and styles reach their edges; zero Loss and reopen
\brdrt/\brdrl -> w:pBdr top/left, \brdrbar/\brdrbtw -> bar/between; zero Loss and reopen
\trbrdrt/\trbrdrb reach RowProperties.exception_borders and survive w:tblPrEx reopen
\clbrdrt\brdrtbl drops the cell top override (inherit) and is not a loss; a sibling \clbrdrl\brdrnil still lands
\clhidemark/\clpad*/\clftsWidth+\clwWidth/\clcbpat+\clshdng/\cldgll reach hideMark/margins/tcW/shd/tl2br; zero Loss and reopen
\trgaph -> w:tblCellMar and \trcbpat shades the row's cells; \chshdng+\chcbpat -> w:rPr/w:shd solid
\itap2 rejects with the named feature `nested-table-structure` (no flatten)
\pgbrdrt\brdrs\brdrw20\brdrcf1 -> section w:pgBorders/w:top single sz=8 colour FF0000; \pgbrdrb\brdrdb -> w:bottom double; zero Loss and reopen
\chbrdr\brdrs\brdrw10 -> w:rPr/w:bdr single sz=4 and survives reopen (reader retains w:bdr)
